what_this_is: The Phase 2 preregistration lock: the exact locked (peer, anchor-event) set, target definition, and model spec, fixed before any target/outcome value has been computed for any peer around any locked anchor event. See 'LOOK-AHEAD DISCLOSURE' below for exactly what has and has not already been touched.
what_this_is_not: Not a result, not the one locked run (a separate, later, not-yet-built module), and not permission to compute anything. It constrains what that later, separate, explicitly-authorized run may do; it performs none. No Phase 3 authorization has been drafted, requested, or signed for HYP-06 as of this lock -- that is a distinct, later, separately-authorized decision this document does not make.

target_definition.formula: RVar(h) = (1/h) * sum_{i=1..h} r_i^2 over [t+1, t+h]; RVar_ref = (1/20) * sum r_i^2 over the trailing 20 sessions ending at the anchor's earnings date; raw = log(RVar(h)) - log(RVar_ref); target = raw - earnings_cycle_baseline(peer, days_to_own_earnings) -- IDENTICAL to HYP-04's own locked formula, reused unchanged, not re-derived.
target_definition.residualization: REQUIRED, not optional -- same as HYP-04.
target_definition.source: HYP-05's own signed Phase 2 lock's target_definition, reused verbatim, not re-derived.

model_spec.estimator: local projections with CR2 clustered standard errors, Satterthwaite degrees of freedom, and max-T permutation multiplicity correction -- reused unmodified from inference.py/clustered_se.py
model_spec.primary_cluster_key_note: HYP-05's own re-decision (clustered_se.HYP05_TWO_WAY_LIMITATION_NOTE), NOT HYP-04's D1-locked calendar_period. With one peer and one anchor, event_id clustering here means exactly 8 clusters (one per locked event) -- a small-sample scenario, consistent with the exploratory framing below.
model_spec.secondary_cluster_key_note: Reported via clustered_se.dual_cluster_report -- two ONE-WAY clusterings shown side by side, never a two-way estimator. The primary result above is HYP-05's actual inferential result; this is a robustness lens only.
model_spec.n_permutations_note: Reused from HYP-04's own constants -- permutation-test validity does not depend on N being large, only power does, and power is already disclosed as inadequate below.
model_spec.source: HYP-05's own signed Phase 2 lock's model_spec, reused verbatim, not re-derived.

sample_size_disclosure.why: 778 locked (peer, event) pairs clears the provisional 195-pair floor by 4.0x -- unlike HYP-05's own 8-event pilot, which fell ~24x short. Still framed exploratory, not confirmatory: the floor itself remains PROVISIONAL (borrowed, not measured against HYP-06's own design) -- see HYP06_SAMPLE_SIZE_GATE_2026-09-13.md.

look_ahead_disclosure.already_touched: Every locked peer's raw close prices (auto_adjust=False) were fetched and used ONLY to compute point-in-time MARKET CAP for PS-1..PS-4 eligibility screening in run_hyp05_peer_market_cap.py (committed b3983ba). That computation never touched any peer's returns, realized variance, or any quantity resembling this hypothesis's target measure. Relationship direction (customer/supplier) was hand-corrected from filing text during round-6 review, which also never touches return data.
look_ahead_disclosure.not_touched: No log return, no realized-variance ratio, and no residualized target value has been computed for any locked peer around any locked anchor event, at any horizon, before this lock. This lock is written before that computation happens for the first time.

opens_no_gate: This is a computed HYP-06 Phase 2 lock, not a freeze, not a registry change, not a linkage ratification. It moves no gate condition, whatever the gate reads at the moment this file is read.
attestation_text: HYP-06's Phase 2 lock -- target definition, model spec (reused verbatim from HYP-05's own signed lock), and the locked 778-pair, 25-peer, 29-anchor set -- was fixed before any return, realized-variance, or target value was computed for any locked peer around any locked anchor event. Every locked peer's raw closes were touched only to compute point-in-time market cap for peer-eligibility screening, never their returns or outcome.
